topic: Kubernetes namespaces — commands and use cases
linkedin_hook: Mastering Kubernetes namespaces is crucial for efficient cluster management, and I'm sharing my top commands and use cases to help you get started.
linkedin_intro: As a senior DevOps engineer, I've worked with numerous Kubernetes clusters and have learned the importance of proper namespace management. In this cheatsheet, I'll share the most useful commands and configurations I use daily. From basic namespace creation to advanced network policies, I've got you covered.

pro_tips: Use the 'kubectl config set-context' command to set the current namespace for your Kubernetes context, and avoid having to specify the namespace for every command.
Use labels and annotations to organize and filter your namespaces, and make it easier to manage your cluster.
Use network policies to control traffic flow between pods and services, and improve the security of your cluster.
Use RBAC to control access to your cluster, and ensure that users and services have the necessary permissions to perform their tasks.
